rationale: The Latin anchors *compensatio*, *emendatio*, and *reparatio* all point to a concrete, material payment made to remedy a loss or injury — precisely the legal/monetary sense of OE *bót* as wergild-style reparation. This matches compensation.n.01 ("something given or received as payment or reparation for a service or loss or injury") far better than the psychiatric defense-mechanism sense (n.02) or the abstract act-of-compensating sense (recompense.n.02).
